_doc: The 3D dungeon prototype (0.139, dungeon-lab/ + src/explore/): a corridor to walk with WASD / arrows and mouselook. Distances in metres. gen = the floor generator (mapgen.js, sizes in cells): width x height, up to `rooms` rooms of roomMin..roomMax cells a side (the boss chamber bossSize), roomGap cells of rock between rooms, `encounters` combat rooms, `loops` extra corridor links, `deadEnds` spurs up to deadEndMax long, seed = the first floor (?seed=N in the lab's URL overrides; the N key = next floor), reveal = how many cells around the knight the map uncovers. light: party = the knight's own torch (rides with the camera), torch = the wall torches (pool = how many of the nearest are lit; intensities in candela), ambient = the hemisphere fill that gives the shadows their olive tone. paint = the ink-and-paint post pass (after Darkest Dungeon 2 and assets/bg/castle_dungeon.jpg), graded in display space: edge = ink outline strength, edgeWidth in pixels, bands = light steps (bandMix how strongly), desat, inkBelow = brightness under which shadows turn to hatched ink, shadow/highlight = tints of the dark and lit values. decor.torchSpacing = minimum distance between wall torches, in cells.
